request_segments: each complete prompt in successive 32-token prefill chunks, then two reference-selected one-token decode requests; reset at prompt start

local_rules.gather_phase_pack_crop_bias_add_multiply: exact FP32 or half bit patterns against independent checkpoint data and actual GPU predecessors; cache updates compare entire state including untouched positions
local_rules.MMA: exact measured fresh-64-K fold on independently converted checkpoint weights
local_rules.attention_scores_context: exact sequential FP32 FMA model including scalar FTZ
local_rules.rms_softmax_silu: 2e-5*(1+abs(reference)); FP64 RMS, defined lane-local plus XOR sum, measured scalar SiLU expansion
local_rules.logits: 2e-5+2e-6*sum(abs(source_i*original_BF16_weight_i)); streamed FP64 dot using actual GPU final norm

quality_rules.original_checkpoint: complete-prompt and decode last-valid-row logits: error <= .05+.003*abs(reference); incomplete-prefix comparison recorded but not admitted under this bound
quality_rules.reset_repeat: all per-stage hashes of repeated prompt and its decode steps must be identical
quality_rules.cache: valid length equals request control; cache data untouched outside append positions

scope: full decoder numerical admission protocol; registration alone grants no hardware result
reference_corrections: decode pack padding follows native FP32 multiplication including signed zero; exact bit comparison is retained
